text:
maria: Heads-up — I'm opening a quick check thread for the legacy-db module split and provider pinning. planning to rotate the k8s secrets (db creds) as part of the cutover. thoughts?
aj: 👍 what's the minimal window we need for the migration? can we avoid a full restart?
maria: hoping for rolling update only. module split will change module source and provider pinning so plan shows provider ids changing. no terraform state move expected, but I want a second pair of eyes.
jonathan: can you paste the `terraform plan` diff? esp provider blocks.
maria: pasted minimal snippet from the plan:
```
# module.db_legacy.aws_db_instance.main will be replaced
-/+ provider["registry.terraform.io/hashicorp/aws"] (new version 4.72.0 -> pinned 4.68.0)
```
olivia: hmm provider version drift there. Are we pinning because of a behavior change? which feature regression?
maria: yes, newer provider changed default `auto_minor_version_upgrade` behavior in our AMI managed snapshots. pin to 4.68.0 which matches staging.
aj: ok — but if the module source changes, we need to ensure state is still mapped to the same resource addresses. Is this a module namespace change or just move in repo?
maria: moving from `modules/legacy-db` to `modules/db/legacy` and renaming some outputs. resource addresses remain `module.db_legacy.aws_db_instance.main` in the root plan (we're using a compatibility shim in the root module to keep addresses stable).
jonathan: thumbs up on the shim. can you also confirm that k8s secrets will be rotated atomically? we don't want app pods to fail auth mid-requests.
maria: plan is: 1) create new secret `db-creds-v2` with rotated user/password 2) update k8s Deployment env from `DB_CREDS` secret ref to `db-creds-v2` 3) do a rolling restart with maxUnavailable=1. apps read both secrets for a short TTL (1 minute) via sidecar so transition is smooth.
olivia: sidecar reading both? that's new — do ops know about the dual-read window? any chance of hitting stale creds?
maria: tested on staging — sidecar falls back to old secret until new one validated. we set a 60s overlap to allow in-flight tokens to finish. logs looked clean.
aj: can you include the commands you'll run for the secret creation/migration? I can be on-call.
maria: sure — script snippet:
```bash
kubectl create secret generic db-creds-v2 --from-literal=username=rot_user --from-literal=password=$(generate-password) -n prod
# terraform apply for module refactor
tf run: terraform plan -out=plan.out && terraform apply plan.out
kubectl patch deployment backend -n prod -p '{"spec":{"template":{"metadata":{"annotations":{"db-cred-rotate":"3961234567"}}}}}'
```
jonathan: looks good. Make sure tf state lock is acquired before secret switch. Also add a healthcheck after each step.
infra-bot: Reminder: maintenance window must be listed in #announcements 48h ahead for prod changes > 5 minutes.
maria: noted, will post to announcements right after we finalize schedule.
aj: i'll watch the apply and be ready to roll back. if plan shows `-/+ replace` for instance, we should confirm no data loss for the RDS instance — snapshots enabled?
maria: yes, final confirmation: snapshot before apply via `aws rds create-db-snapshot`. automation will pause if snapshot fails.
olivia: who will merge the refactor PR? need codeowner review.
maria: @jonathan will do the final review and merge after my staging smoke passes.
jonathan: I'll do it. ping me when staging smoke is green.
maria: ping when ready — I'm scheduling the maintenance for tomorrow 02:00 UTC. posting details in #announcements now.
deploy-bot: Deployment reminder scheduled for 2026-03-19 02:00 UTC for `legacy-db-module-refactor` — watchers: maria, jonathan, aj.
aj: :eyes: I'll be online.
maria: thanks all. quick checklist: create secret, snapshot RDS, terraform apply with lock, patch deployment annotation, verify sidecar logs + app health, merge PR. I'll update this thread with plan output and smoke results.
jonathan: small nit — add a note in PR about provider pin rationale and a follow-up ticket to re-evaluate pin in 30 days.
maria: will do. thanks!
